readDisposition.rationale: Read-only inventory, capability evidence, or audit data.

actions.rationale: Workflow, runner, artifact, or cache operation; durable policy exceptions are overridden explicitly.

activity.rationale: Transient subscription, starring, watching, or feed activity.

agents.rationale: Agent task lifecycle rather than durable governance state.

billing.rationale: Billing policy has organization-wide financial impact.

campaigns.rationale: Security campaign lifecycle is an explicit workflow.

checks.rationale: Check runs and suites are execution history.

code-scanning.rationale: Security configuration; alert workflow exceptions are overridden explicitly.

codespaces.rationale: Codespace lifecycle; secret and policy exceptions are overridden explicitly.

copilot.rationale: Durable product access and organization policy.

dependabot.rationale: Dependabot secrets and repository access; alert workflow exceptions are overridden explicitly.

dependency-graph.rationale: Snapshot and SBOM submission is an event, not desired state.

gists.rationale: Content creation workflow outside repository governance.

git.rationale: Git object/ref mutation is explicit content workflow; current branch creation is a bounded implemented exception.

issues.rationale: Issue, comment, label, milestone, and assignment workflow.

licenses.rationale: No ordinary durable governance mutation is expected in this family.

migrations.rationale: Migration lifecycle is explicit and transactional.

orgs.rationale: Durable organization settings, access, roles, custom properties, and rules.

projects.rationale: Project content and workflow are outside governance reconciliation.

repos.rationale: Durable repository state; destructive and workflow exceptions are overridden explicitly.

secret-scanning.rationale: Secret scanning configuration; alert resolution is overridden explicitly.

teams.rationale: Durable team membership, hierarchy, and repository access.

users.rationale: User profile, identity, keys, and account policy; transient exceptions are overridden explicitly.

overrides.rationale: Repository deletion is never inferred from desired-state omission.
Ownership transfer is outside normal reconciliation.
Organization deletion is never inferred from desired-state omission.
Membership conversion is an explicit actor-driven access workflow.
Durable access, secret, identity, webhook, runner, or trust state with elevated impact.
Durable Actions execution and token policy.
Durable deployment environment and protection policy.
Finding resolution or campaign workflow is explicit, not desired-state reconciliation.
Release, deployment, and status records are historical workflow.
Invitation acceptance and lifecycle are actor-driven operations.
